name: Personal health record
blurb: One person's lab results, readings, targets, hypotheses, medication and vaccine doses, with "off target", "overdue" and "incomplete" worked out on every read.
about: A personal health record that holds your results, readings and vaccinations against your own targets, so you see what is off target, overdue or unfinished each time you ask. Each result, reading, medication and vaccine dose links to the document it came from and to the target or series it belongs to. Agents read your reports and tell you what is due, on branches you review before anything reaches the record.
sample: Noa Brandt, an invented person with two years of results

questions.q: Which results are outside my own targets?
